[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]Deployed provider skill files are a pure function of one canonical [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]committed source revision, a deploy can never move the destination [/#D7D7AF]

[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Source-integrity guard for skill deploys[/bold #D7AFFF]                      [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]guard[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]guard: refuse a chezmoi skill deploy when the invoking workspace has [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]uncommitted xprompt template edits or a HEAD that is not an ancestor of [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]the canonical branch, add an --allow-dirty escape hatch, and leave [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]read-only and non-chezmoi paths untouched.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Provenance manifest and monotonic overwrite guard[/bold #D7AFFF]             [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]manifest[dim] · [dim][/dim]after guard[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]manifest: record the source commit and xprompt-set hash in a [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]chezmoi-versioned JSON manifest, then refuse deploys whose source [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]revision is a descendant of or unrelated to the recorded one, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]bootstrapping cleanly when the manifest is missing.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  3 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Serialize the deploy and make it attributable[/bold #D7AFFF]                 [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]serialize[dim] · [dim][/dim]after manifest[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]serialize: wrap the chezmoi read-compare-write-commit-push sequence in [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]an exclusive lock reusing an existing lock helper, and extend the commit[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]trailers to record source revision, workspace, and agent on both the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]direct and deferred deploy paths.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  4 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Reconcile the unlanded sase_beads template onto master[/bold #D7AFFF]        [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]reconcile[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]reconcile: merge the three divergent sase_beads template variants into [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]one template on master, verifying every documented bead command against [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]the actual CLI before landing, so the guards do not enforce a source of [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]truth that is missing content.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  5 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Regenerate from reconciled source and confirm convergence[/bold #D7AFFF]     [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]converge[dim] · [dim][/dim]after guard, manifest, serialize, reconcile[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]converge: deploy once from a clean canonical workspace, confirm a re-run[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]is a no-op and that an older workspace is refused rather than reverting,[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]reproduce the original ABA against the fixed code, and remove the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]orphaned dot_gemini skills tree.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  6 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Document the corrected skill-deploy workflow[/bold #D7AFFF]                  [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]

    [#D7D7AF]with the commit-then-deploy workflow, after asking the user directly for[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]memory-file approval and falling back to CLI help and docs if it is [/#D7D7AF]
